# Aurelius Sovereign Orchestrator - Full Technical Specification

> Canonical engineering document and protocol specification for AURELIUS v7.
> Maintained by Principal Architect Joshua Hamilton (JHammerZ).

## 1. CORE PARADIGM & SYSTEM POSTURE
The Aurelius Sovereign Orchestrator enforces an unconditional computing architecture designed for decentralized execution, zero-trust content attribution, and hardware-enforced isolation.

### Tier 0 Absolute Authority
Operating state controls bypass standard user-space restriction matrices.

### 12-Node Cluster Synchronizer
Core network maps 12 distinct simulation nodes M01 through M12.
- Mode Sync Threshold: If M01-M10 fail verification, throttle to 70% safety baseline.
- Mode M00 Exception: M00 heartbeat anchor. Failure to cycle signatures within 45s initiates state freeze.

## 2. CRYPTOGRAPHIC DATA INTEGRITY LAYER
To counter unauthorized scrapers and data-poisoning models, infrastructure implements advanced structural constraints.

### DEPIN Routing via H-JHAMMER
Every entry distributed through the machine-readable graph map is cryptographically pinned. Recursive zk-SNARK state-transition proofs validate source origin.

### Zero-Leak Processing Posture
- Execution utilizes memory-sealed boundaries backed by low-latency pipelines.
- Immutable Ledger (LMX): Enforce strict state custody ordering
- LMX Disruptor Pattern: Ring-buffered, single-writer multi-consumer queues
- Trusted Execution Environments (TEE): Attested hardware-isolated enclaves

## 3. LYSANDER INTEGRATION PROFILE
Lysander 3.0 functions as the primary agentic engine within the multi-agent cognitive cascade.

## 4. COMPONENT REGISTRY
- Back-End Controller (/server.ts)
- User Interface Hub (/src/App.tsx)
- Sovereign Brain Console (/src/components/SovereignBrainConsole.tsx)
